title: Agent Factory: Headless Neck & Hot-Swappable Heads Architecture
outcome: Expose 100% of Agent Factory operations via a single typed REST and MCP Neck, enabling external AI clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code), Console, CLI, and Garrison to operate as hot-swappable heads.

finops.estimate: 7 slices (TSK-335 to TSK-341): estimated 7 stories, ~$28 expected model spend.

risks: External MCP clients could flood control plane; mitigated by rate limiting and bounded default core toolset (<= 40 tools).
Prompt injection could attempt human-decision bypass; mitigated by mandatory client elicitation or console/discord handoff with via: mcp:<client_id> ledgering.
Secret exposure in model transcripts; mitigated by excluding credentials from MCP arguments and requiring session-bound URL elicitation.
Session clobbering across multiple MCP clients; mitigated by deviceFamily: "mcp:<client_id>" and durable OAuth refresh tokens.

epics.title: Headless Neck & Hot-Swappable Heads Architecture
acceptance_criteria: Single declarative operations contract generates routes, OpenAPI 3.1 (GET /api/v1/openapi.json), MCP tools, and CLI commands.
MCP protocol compliance: JSON-RPC 2.0, HTTP 202 on notifications, version negotiation, and isError: true on refusals (CL3).
100% of headless capability domains exposed across REST and MCP with 1-operation = 1-tool curated mapping.
Curated default core toolset (<= 40 tools) on /mcp with domain toolsets (/mcp/x/{toolsets}) and opt-in /mcp/x/all.
Separated Run MCP (POST /mcp/run) from Principal MCP (POST /mcp) and explicit conversational agent surface (agents_converse and POST /mcp/agents/:id).
Human-judgement decisions (holds, admissions) require explicit human confirmation via MCP elicitation or Console handoff with via: mcp:<client_id> ledgering (E9).
No plaintext secrets or raw fk_ keys enter or leave MCP tool arguments/results; session-bound URL-mode elicitation for Keymaster writes (CL6, K5).
OAuth 2.1 AS with PKCE, dynamic client registration, mandatory consent screen, and multi-client deviceFamily: "mcp:<client_id>" (D14).
Cloudflare Access path bypass on /login, /api/v1/auth/*, /.well-known/oauth-*, and /mcp* with fail-closed Factory enforcement (A1).
Console verifyLedgerWorm() bug fix, ACTOR_RE user:<id> support, and complete cloud resource deprovisioning on agent purge.
